title: Synthetic serum markers enable noninvasive monitoring of gene expression in primate brains
authors: Sangsin Lee, McKenna D. Romac, Sho Watanabe, Mykyta Chernov, Honghao Li, Emma Raisley, Kathryn M. Rothenhoefer, Zachary Dahlquist, Jerzy O. Szablowski, Vincent D. Costa
abstract: Lee, Romac, et al. develop NHP-RMAs, synthetic serum markers for monitoring of transgene expression in nonhuman primates. These reporters cross the blood-brain barrier, providing a longitudinal, circuit-specific readout of gene expression via simple blood tests. Peak serum signals correlate strongly…

title: Endogenous retrovirus-derived RNA-DNA hybrids induce microglial synaptic pruning in autism models
authors: Shaoxuan Chen, Boxin Zhang, Tianyu Qin, Mengyue Zhu, Qiang Chen, Lu Xia, Huifang Pan, Qihua Yang, Shuanghui Guo, Rui Gong, Qiwu Jiang, Hongda Li, Xueqin Zhang, Pu Cheng, Xuchen Qi, Wei Chen, Wei Mo
abstract: Based on mouse models of MIA and Setdb1 deficiency, the study by Chen et al. identifies an ERV-mediated C4b-microglia pathway in autism. The authors propose that RTI intervention targeting ERV reverse transcription may modulate C4b-microglia activation and alleviate autism symptoms.

authors: Matthew F. Collie, Chennan Jin, Victoria Rockwell, Emily Kellogg, Quinn X. Vanderbeck, Alexandra K. Hartman, Stephen L. Holtz, Rachel I. Wilson
